summary: Completed comprehensive testing of 4 new features: Conversion Funnel, Real Email Sending (Gmail SMTP), Lounge Member Profiles, and Scheduled Announcements. All features working as expected.

backend_issues.notes: Gmail SMTP auth failure (535) is EXPECTED — user provided regular password instead of App Password. System gracefully falls back to logged sends.

passed_tests: POST /api/analytics/track accepts 'sid' field and stores it
GET /api/admin/funnel?days=30 returns funnel data with total_sessions, per-source rows (visits/pricing_views/checkouts_started/conversions/conversion_rate), and overall totals
GET /api/admin/funnel (non-admin) returns 403
GET /api/admin/email/status returns enabled:true, provider:'gmail_smtp', last_error with App Password failure (535), verified:false
POST /api/admin/email/test returns status 'failed — logged only' (Gmail 535 EXPECTED) and send is logged in email_logs
GET /api/admin/email/status (non-admin) returns 403
GET /api/community/members/{uid} for admin returns name, role:'admin', is_premium:true, joined, thread_count>0, reply_count, recent_threads array
GET /api/community/members/{uid} (free user) returns 403
GET /api/community/members/{uid} (unknown uid) returns 404
POST /api/community/announcements with future publish_at returns scheduled:true
GET /api/community/announcements (admin) includes scheduled announcements with scheduled:true
POST /api/community/announcements with invalid publish_at returns 400
POST /api/community/announcements without publish_at publishes immediately (scheduled:false)
